articles.title: 퀘스트 2.10 PTC가 보여준 방향: 헤드셋은 이제 '보는 기기'에서 '훈련하는 기기'로

articles.body: 퀘스트 2.10 PTC가 보여준 방향: 헤드셋은 이제 '보는 기기'에서 '훈련하는 기기'로 업로드VR에 따르면, 퀘스트의 Horizon OS 2.10 PTC 업데이트가 배포 중이며 새 극장(시어터) 환경과 간결해진 내비게이터 런처 재설계가 포함됐습니다. 표면적으로는 인터페이스 개선 뉴스입니다. 하지만 이 업데이트가 던지는 신호는 조금 더 큽니다. VR 헤드셋이 미디어 소비 기기로서 더 편안해지고 있다는 것, 그리고 그만큼 헤드셋을 쓰는 '시간'이 일상에 자연스럽게 자리 잡고 있다는 뜻이기 때문입니다. 그렇다면 질문을 하나 바꿔봅시다. 그 시간을 그냥 흘려보내야 할까요? 저는 이 질문을 꽤 오래 붙들고 있었습니다. 개발자로서 VR 파이프라인을 만지작거리던 어느 밤, 문득 이런 생각이 들었습니다. 헤드셋이 '콘텐츠를 소비하는 창'에서 '무언가를 훈련하는 도구'로 넘어가려면, 결국 렌더링 파이프라인 위에서 시선과 주의를 어떻게 다룰 것인가가 관건이구나, 하고요. 퀘스트 2.10 PTC의 시어터 환경과 런처 재설계는 화려한 뉴스가 아닙니다. 하지만 이건 조용한 신호입니다. 헤드셋 착용 시간이 길어지고, 그 시간이 일상 루틴에 편입되고 있다는 신호. 그러면 자연스럽게 다음 질문이 따라옵니다. 그 시간을 어떻게 쓸 것인가. 약시(lazy eye)와 '너무 늦었다'는 말 약시나 시각 협응 문제를 가진 사람들은 흔히 이런 말을 듣습니다. "성인에게는 효과가 제한적이다." 물론 어린 시절의 개입이 중요하다는 것은 사실입니다. 하지만 시각 훈련은 어린이만의 것이 아닙니다. 문제는 방법이었습니다.
articles.author: Ashish

articles.title: Why Assassin's Creed Shadows Bet on Anvil: The Old House Engine Behind a 5-Million-Player Japan Rescue
articles.excerpt: The short answer: Assassin's Creed Shadows runs on an upgraded Ubisoft Anvil, not Unreal Engine 5 or Snowdrop. Ubisoft lists Anvil as the engine for Shadows, and describes Anvil as the in-house tech c…
articles.body: The short answer: Assassin's Creed Shadows runs on an upgraded Ubisoft Anvil , not Unreal Engine 5 or Snowdrop. Ubisoft lists Anvil as the engine for Shadows , and describes Anvil as the in-house tech crafted for the first Assassin's Creed and scaled for massive open worlds and even competitive multiplayer like Rainbow Six Siege on its technology page . That choice looks conservative until you see what it had to carry. Shadows is the fourteenth main Assassin's Creed, developed by Ubisoft Quebec as the successor to Mirage, set in 16th-century Japan at the end of the Sengoku period with two very different leads — shinobi Naoe and samurai Yasuke. It launched March 20, 2025 for macOS, PS5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S, with a Switch 2 version December 2, 2025 and iPadOS to follow.
articles.author: dev game

articles.body: Setelah mengikuti panduan ini, Claude (chat claude.ai dengan connector, atau Claude Code di terminal Anda) menjawab pertanyaan support dan produk dari salah satu knowledge base osFoundry milik Anda. Setiap klaim dalam jawabannya merujuk ke ID artikel dan waktu terakhir artikel itu diperbarui. Keesokan harinya, Claude bisa menanyakan ke osFoundry apa saja yang berubah sejak itu, lalu memberi tahu Anda jawaban kemarin mana yang bersandar pada artikel yang sudah ditulis ulang oleh seseorang. Kalau artikelnya sendiri yang salah, Claude bisa memperbaikinya, tetapi hanya dari versi persis yang ia baca, dan hanya setelah Anda mengizinkan pemanggilannya.

articles.title: AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence — Ch.25: Future of Embodied AI [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 25 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/25_Future_of_Embodied_AI/25_Future_of_Embodied_AI_KR.m…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 25 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/25_Future_of_Embodied_AI/25_Future_of_Embodied_AI_KR.md Volume 06. AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence Chapter 25. Future of Embodied AI 25.1 Next-Generation Embodied AI 25_01 차세대 체화형 AI (Next Generation Embodied AI) 차세대 체화형 AI(Embodied AI)는 고도화된 인공지능, 로보틱스, 월드 모델(World Model), 멀티모달 인식, 자율 의사결정, 그리고 평생학습(Lifelong Learning)이 하나의 통합된 물리적 시스템으로 융합되는 미래 기술을 의미한다. 기존의 로봇이 사전에 정의된 규칙, 고정된 작업 흐름, 그리고 통제된 환경에 의존했다면, 차세대 체화형 AI는 실제 세계와 지속적으로 상호작용하며 스스로 학습하고 추론하며 적응할 수 있다. 이는 단순한 자동화 기술에서 벗어나 일반 목적의 지능형 로봇으로 발전하는 과정이며, 미래의 로봇은 목표를 이해하고 상황을 해석하며 결과를 예측하고 적절한 행동을 수행하는 능력을 갖추게 된다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence — Ch.24: AGI and Robotics [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 24 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/24_AGI_and_Robotics/24_AGI_and_Robotics_KR.md Volume 0…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 24 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/24_AGI_and_Robotics/24_AGI_and_Robotics_KR.md Volume 06. AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence Chapter 24. AGI and Robotics 24.1 AGI Concepts for Robotics 인공지능 일반지능(AGI, Artificial General Intelligence)은 미래 로보틱스 발전에서 가장 혁신적인 개념 중 하나로 평가된다. 현재의 로봇 시스템은 일반적으로 특정 환경에서 특정 작업을 수행하도록 설계되어 있지만, AGI는 인간과 유사하거나 그 이상의 수준으로 이해하고, 추론하고, 학습하며, 적응할 수 있는 범용 지능을 지향한다. 로봇 분야에서 AGI는 단순히 인식 정확도를 높이거나 자율주행 성능을 향상시키는 것을 의미하지 않는다. 그것은 특정 작업에 최적화된 자동화 시스템에서 벗어나, 예측하기 어려운 현실 세계 환경에서도 스스로 문제를 이해하고 해결할 수 있는 범용 자율지능으로의 근본적인 전환을 의미한다. 이러한 개념은 파운데이션 모델, 로봇 에이전트, 월드 모델(World Model), 멀티모달 AI, 강화학습, 임바디드 AI(Embodied AI) 등의 발전을 통해 자연스럽게 등장하고 있다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence — Ch.23: Industrial AI Case Studies [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 23 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/23_Industrial_AI_Case_Studies/23_Industrial_AI_Case_St…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 23 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/23_Industrial_AI_Case_Studies/23_Industrial_AI_Case_Studies_KR.md Volume 06. AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence Chapter 23. Industrial AI Case Studies 23.1 Warehouse AMR AI Case Study 23_01_Warehouse_AMR_AI 사례 연구 창고용 자율이동로봇(AMR)은 현대 물류 산업에서 가장 성공적으로 적용된 인공지능 사례 중 하나이다. 전 세계적으로 전자상거래, 옴니채널 물류, 적시생산(Just-In-Time) 공급망이 확대되면서 창고는 처리량 향상, 인력 의존도 감소, 안전성 강화, 서비스 품질 향상이라는 과제에 직면하고 있다. 기존의 컨베이어 시스템, 고정 경로 기반 AGV, 수동 지게차는 일정 수준의 자동화를 제공하지만 창고 레이아웃이나 물류 흐름이 변화할 경우 유연성이 부족하다. AI 기반 AMR은 자율주행, 지능형 인지, 플릿 최적화, 작업 할당, 지속적 학습 기능을 결합하여 이러한 문제를 해결한다. 창고 AMR AI 사례는 물류 자동화가 단순한 기계화 수준을 넘어 실시간 의사결정이 가능한 지능형 시스템으로 발전하는 과정을 보여준다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence — Ch.22: AI Monitoring and Validation [KR]
articles.excerpt: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 22 · KR https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/22_AI_Monitoring_and_Validation/22_AI_Monitoring_and_V…
articles.body: STATERA Library · Series 02 · Volume 06 · Chapter 22 · KR Source: https://github.com/Statera-Library/02_Vol_06_AMR_AI_and_Embodied_Intelligence/blob/main/22_AI_Monitoring_and_Validation/22_AI_Monitoring_and_Validation_KR.md Volume 06. AMR AI and Embodied Intelligence Chapter 22. AI Monitoring and Validation 22.1 AI Model Monitoring Overview 22_01_AI 모델 모니터링 개요 (AI Model Monitoring Overview) 인공지능은 현대 자율이동로봇(AMR), 자율주행 차량, 서비스 로봇, 산업용 검사 로봇, 물류 자동화 시스템, 그리고 차세대 Embodied AI 플랫폼의 핵심 구성 요소가 되었다. AI 모델이 인식(Perception), 추론(Reasoning), 의사결정(Decision Making), 예측(Prediction), 상호작용(Interaction) 등의 역할을 담당하게 되면서, 이러한 모델을 운영 전 과정에서 지속적으로 관찰하고 관리하는 AI 모델 모니터링의 중요성이 크게 증가하고 있다. AI 모니터링은 더 이상 배포 이후에 수행하는 부가적인 활동이 아니라, 전체 AI 시스템 아키텍처와 운영 전략의 필수 구성 요소로 자리 잡고 있다.
articles.author: Richard Minsoo Go

articles.title: Yes, it runs 'Doom': Satellite plays iconic game in world's 1st demonstration of orbital voice control
articles.excerpt: The world's first voice command of a satellite saw an experimental European spacecraft play the iconic video game 'Doom' after operators spoke to it from Earth.
articles.body: A satellite went knee-deep in the dead, after a voice command from the ground activated the Doom video game in space. Playing a first-person shooter from 1993 was obviously not in the design plan for the PRETTY cubesat , which is run by a consortium including the European Space Agency (ESA). But the pioneering voice command opens up new worlds for satellite work, the team says. "Someone in distress at sea or in a remote area could transmit 'mayday' or "help" on a radio," stated Estonia's Tanagra Space, which supplied the software for the feat. The hope is one day, a satellite could use transcription and AI to alert rescue services for assisting folks in remote zones. The call to play Doom, thankfully, had no other urgency than curiosity — and teamwork, fueled by pizza.
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

articles.title: 13 Years Later, the Greatest Studio Ghibli Movie Not From Ghibli Is Free on Streaming
articles.excerpt: Laika Studios echoed Studio Ghibli's magic perfectly in 2016 with 'Kubo and the Two Strings.' Find out why.
articles.body: When Studio Ghibli co-founder Hayao Miyazaki announced his retirement from filmmaking in 2013, much of the world let out a wail of despair . Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli captivated audiences worldwide with breathtaking animation, imaginative worlds, and whimsical stories for over three decades. Beloved films such as My Neighbor Totoro (1988) and Kiki’s Delivery Service (1989) showcased the studio’s distinctive charm and Miyazaki’s remarkable creative vision.

articles.title: I revisited the Kindle Colorsoft, and I can’t wait to go back to my Kindle Paperwhite
articles.excerpt: Yes, the Kindle Colorsoft's color screen is pretty, but I've missed my Kindle Paperwhite.
articles.body: For the last couple of years, I’ve been reading on the Kindle Paperwhite (2024) every day, and have really enjoyed it. It has reignited my love for books, and if I didn’t own it, I probably wouldn’t be reading much at all. It’s so convenient, takes up no space, and is very low maintenance for a mobile device. Then, when looking through some devices I wanted to revisit, I found the Kindle Colorsoft . I wasn’t all that taken with it when I originally reviewed it, and went back to the Paperwhite soon after finishing with it. It’s where I’ve remained ever since.

articles.title: I wouldn’t buy a phone released in 2026, and neither should you
articles.excerpt: Newer doesn't always mean better, especially when it costs more.
articles.body: We don’t realize how big a factor price is when buying a new smartphone until it gets out of hand, and that’s exactly what’s happening these days, with phone prices rising so quickly that they are becoming borderline unaffordable, even though hardware improvements remain nearly flat. It feels like getting handed the short end of the stick — you are paying more for essentially the same internals. So why not actually get a device from last year and save some cash? Previous-gen handsets are becoming increasingly lucrative and wiser options, amidst all the price hikes happening left, right, and center. I personally wouldn’t buy a phone released this year, just because of how much more sense their predecessors make.
articles.author: Karandeep Singh

articles.title: The climate case for AI has not been made
articles.excerpt: This week, as countries meet in Antalya, Turkey for the United Nations climate conference, one topic likely to dominate the conversation is artificial intelligence. The host has already called on coun…
articles.body: This week, as countries meet in Antalya, Turkey for the United Nations climate conference, one topic likely to dominate the conversation is artificial intelligence. The host has already called on countries to commit to ensuring that AI is designed, powered, and deployed in ways that support climate action. But so far, industries around the world aren’t doing nearly enough to harness the technology to actually drive down the greenhouse-gas emissions heating up the planet, despite some very optimistic claims from AI companies.

articles.title: Snapseed tests finer quality and Exif controls for saving and batch editing images
articles.excerpt: Snapseed could allow users to assign different settings for when they save, export, or batch edit photos.
articles.body: Credit: Akshay Gangwar / Android Authority TL;DR Google is testing finer controls for image quality and the inclusion of Exif data across different image-saving modes on Snapseed. Currently, these settings are consolidated for all output modes. Snapseed could soon let users set different options depending on whether they export, save, or batch-edit photos. The renewed Snapseed photo editor launched on iOS and Android earlier this year, and Google has since rolled out several useful features. articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
articles.excerpt: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. Here's why Venus Express mattered.
articles.body: On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this.
